toastDone: Full-pack done. {total} entities will now export with your mod.
buttonTitle: Full-pack mode · also export vanilla content as part of my mod (only large total-conversion mods need this)
buttonLabel: Full-pack mode (advanced · most mods don't need it)
descDone: Marked {total} entities. The next export zip will include this vanilla content.
descConfirm: Include every item imported from vanilla (characters / ideas / focuses / events / decisions / tech) in your export, as part of your mod.
previewing: Counting how many items can be included…
warnBody1: Only use it for large total-conversion mods that "fully replace vanilla" (e.g. Kaiserreich / The New Order / Old World Blues).
warnBody2: If you're just adding new content on top of vanilla (a regular mod), you don't need this — close this dialog and export directly.
noFlip: Nothing to include — everything is already set to export.
irreversible: This can't be undone. Once included, these items can't go back to reference-only.
ackText: I confirm this is a large total-conversion mod, I want vanilla content exported as part of my mod, and I understand this can't be undone.
openExportHint: Open the Export Mod page to download the full zip.
